name: QQ Group Owner Guard
description: Execution-time owner checks for QQ group sessions: non-owners may only run allowlisted workspace scripts; owner-only/credential/config tools are blocked for non-owners; at most one early text progress line per turn. Interlock + config for QQ-GROUP-UNIFIED-TOOLS-PATCH v1 (unifiedTools). v1.2.0: per-turn sender hint for non-owner qqbot DM/group turns (senderHint).

ownerIds.description: Extra owner sender ids (commands.ownerAllowFrom is always read)

logSeen.description: Log the first occurrence of each tool shape (default true)

unifiedTools.description: QQ-GROUP-UNIFIED-TOOLS-PATCH v1: in these QQ groups non-owner turns advertise the owner's tool catalog (owner-only tools refused at call time)

senderHint.description: v1.2.0: add a per-turn hint (prependContext) when a qqbot DM/group sender is not in commands.ownerAllowFrom (default true)
